gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Eater has spiky, wide-spaced letters with thin strokes next to weightier stems, and a menacing streak to match. Noto Serif Hentaigana is the traditional counterweight, a serif with open curves and gentle stroke modulation.
gen-eater-gf-ovo: Ovo reads like a classic serif with authority, its tall middle band and thins barely lighter than thicks. Ovo keeps the text steady and spacious beneath Eater, whose dark, aggressive letters sit wide apart up top.
gen-flavors-fs-bespoke-slab: Whimsical and commanding, Flavors has no hairlines to squint at, and its diagonals carry full heft. Bespoke Slab adds grounded, tall-bodied text serif lowercase.
gen-flavors-fs-trench-slab: Flavors draws its strokes like thin plastic tubing bent into loops, with diagonals as heavy as the stems. Flavors brings the play; Trench Slab, a dignified text serif, brings tight, refined caps.
gen-flavors-gf-esteban: Flavors is whimsical but commanding, its towering x-height drawn as a plain, unmodulated outline. Esteban follows in a refined serif whose arches thin slightly, with a wide-open e.
gen-flavors-gf-faustina: Faustina reads like a classic serif with authority, its bowls thinning gently and its c open like pliers. Flavors, built like bent tubing in one gauge, supplies the whimsy while Faustina adds a mild shimmer of weight.
gen-flavors-gf-halant: Flavors lays its letters out like fine rope, with a towering x-height and diagonals as heavy as stems. And Halant, a serif with a faint thick-thin shift, carries the traditional, authoritative side.
gen-flavors-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Flavors is whimsical, with bowls and stems drawn at the same weight. Hedvig Letters Serif adds a sturdy, classic serif body whose weight stretches only slightly, and the two sit comfortably together.
gen-flavors-gf-lisu-bosa: Flavors forms wirelike letters of one thickness, with diagonals as heavy as stems and a towering x-height. Lisu Bosa, a text serif, makes the pair strongest by letting its modulated, editorial words sit large and sturdy.
gen-flavors-gf-marcellus-sc: Flavors draws a single-weight line, like a plotter pen, under a towering x-height. Marcellus SC is the serif that offers a friendly, mild contrast and the literary dignity of cast iron capitals.
